bio.text: Alec Brook-Krasny represents the 46th Assembly District in Kings County, New York, having been elected in November 2022.
He previously served in the Assembly from 2006, representing Coney Island, Bay Ridge and Dyker Heights, and left in 2015.
Born in Moscow, he emigrated to Brooklyn, where he lives, and graduated with dual degrees in engineering and economics from the Moscow Technological Institute.
